name: NEOsync Context Recall + Cross-System Semantic Retrieval

integrations.NEO Algo: Use ranked operational context as bounded reasoning input; preserve source and confidence.
integrations.NEO Oracle: Distinguish recalled facts, internal doctrine, inference, and unknowns; retain provenance.
integrations.GISS NEO LMS: Use approved context for institutional continuity and learning references without exposing private Government data publicly.
integrations.NEOsync: Primary executive recall layer for persistent operational continuity.
integrations.NEO Law: Treat recalled legal records as records/context, not automatic legal conclusions or authority.
integrations.Internal NEO Society: Use recalled norms and decisions only within their recorded scope and status.
integrations.N.I.A. / Project 144: Preserve provenance, confidence, timestamps, and source distinctions in intelligence workflows.
integrations.NEO Router: Route recall requests to the private context-recall service and never to public Hub clients.
integrations.NEO Lingo: Normalize terminology while preserving canonical entity IDs and source meaning.
